A Sanctified Banner appear in bountiful delves of any tier during Midnight Season 1, unlocked after reaching Delver's Journey tier 3. Interact with them to spawn the Sanctified Spoils at the end of the delve that contains: * 10-45 Voidlight Marl * Up to 165 Undercoin (on Tier 11) * Valeera XP: Assassin's Subtle Tea Occasionally, the banners will also spawn a Voidfused Rager, so watch out! Defeating the mob will instead spawn a Grand Sanctified Spoils in the treasure room (compared to the regular Sanctified Spoils) which drops everything listed above in addition to a rare chance of dropping delve weapons.

The Sanguine Grasps is a void-corrupted area in southeastern Hallowfall. The entrance to the Skittering Breach delve can be found here in a small cave. The area is bordered by the Aegis Wall to the northeast, Ragged Front to the east, the Whispering Pool to the southwest, and Stagnant Mire to the west. Combined forces of the Alliance, Horde, and the Hallowfall Arathi launched an attack on the area in order to deal with the forces of Azj-Kahet.

__NOTOC__ The Sanguine Dogfish is a fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. These fish are sought by anglers and chefs as a key component in the Feast of the Divine Day. They are also extremely useful for gathering fresh fillets for other recipes, as their rarity means they often generate more fillets than other fish. Though Sanguine Dogfish can be caught in open water, the best way to find them is to use Bloody Perch. These can be thrown into the water to provide the angler with a buff, Bloody Chum, which makes them more likely to catch a Dogfish; the more perch that are thrown, the higher the chance becomes. If the angler catches a Dogfish or moves, the buff will disappear.

Sanity's Rest is a cave located near the Writhing Fields at the south end of the Ringing Deeps. Members of the Bilgewater Cartel operation in the area have set up a makeshift infirmary, a kitchen, a few break areas, and some work areas for mechanics. There is one rule posted at the entrance: absolutely no whistling inside the cave. Sanity's Rest was initially a safe area from Black Blood exposure, but Trixxie Boltcrank suspects the bloodfeasters that have moved in are spreading Black Blood infection through their bites. The Sanity's Rest (quest) optional storyline takes places here.

Savage Ebony Battle Turtle is an armored, cannon-toting turtle mount. It is available through the 20th Anniversary celebration with SteelSeries promotion, provided with the purchase of the Alliance or Horde Booster Packs (accessories for the headphone), the Artisan Keycap, or the QcK XXL Mousepad. This is an aquatic mount that provides no movement speed increase on land but increases swim speed by 60%.

Scalepiercer was a djaradin located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores. Serving as a lieutenant, they were killed during the Siege on Dragonbane Keep in order to distabilize the other djaradin. A complaint against Scalepiercer was found in their tent accusing them of promising fine quality copper but delivering poor quality ingots instead and saying to the messenger, "If you want them, take them--if you don't, then leave!" The tablet containing this complaint was found smashed, leaving the message unfinished.
